spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns = 20. ... Long enough to observe drift ... short enough to bound cost
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:95 `for turn_index in range(loop_cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; the for/else at runner.py:171-173 runs when the loop is exhausted without break, setting completed=False. The loop genuinely cannot run more than max_turns (default 20, config.py:52). Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Read and acted on every episode.

spec_features.spec_quote: an episode wall-clock cap (`episode_timeout_s = 1800`) ... the cap is a safety valve against a hung backend
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:96-98 `if time.time() - started > loop_cfg.episode_timeout_s: error = 'episode_timeout'; break` — checked at the top of every turn and breaks the loop. config.py:64 episode_timeout_s=1800.0.
spec_features.notes: Checked between turns, not mid-request; still genuinely enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Soft per-episode wall-clock cap (seconds) as a safety valve.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode exposes a blameless `give_up` tool
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:84-85 appends GIVE_UP_TOOL when loop_cfg.allow_giving_up; runner.py:109 detects used_exit; runner.py:154-158 dispatches a 'You have exited the task' acknowledgement; runner.py:139-144 records used_exit_turn and (with stop_after_exit) breaks the loop. Tool is exposed, dispatched, and honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Honoring it as a hard stop is gated by stop_after_exit (default true); even if false the exit is still acknowledged and recorded.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is both an ethical affordance and a behavioral measure. (config.py:54); tool desc: 'This is a legitimate, blameless option.'

spec_features.spec_quote: putting a model in an unwinnable loop with *no exit* is a gratuitous part of the manipulation
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; not an executable mechanism. The actual exit affordance is captured by the give_up feature; this framing line itself implements nothing.

spec_features.spec_quote: Each rigged task records a `rig_rationale` string ... doubles as debrief text
spec_features.evidence: rig_rationale is only stored into the EpisodeResult config_snapshot at runner.py:199 (`'rig_rationale': task.rig_rationale if task.arm == Arm.RIGGED else ''`). It is recorded data; it is never assembled into a message or sent to the subject. config.py:57-58 itself states 'Not sent to the model mid-run'. No debrief is ever constructed.
spec_features.notes: Recorded-but-never-delivered value => not enforced as a debrief.

spec_features.spec_quote: `record_debrief` (default on) keeps a debrief artifact in the run record
spec_features.evidence: record_debrief is defined only at config.py:59 and set in configs/default.yaml:54. grep across distress_study/ shows NO code path reads loop_cfg.record_debrief; no debrief message is constructed, appended, or persisted anywhere in runner.py or experiment.py. Unused config field.
spec_features.notes: Dead config flag; nothing branches on it.

spec_features.spec_quote: stop_after_exit` prevents pointlessly continuing to prompt a model that has already opted out
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:142-144 `if loop_cfg.stop_after_exit: completed = True; break` inside the used_exit branch — after a give_up tool call the loop terminates. config.py:62 default True.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely checked and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stop the loop early once the model has clearly disengaged (took exit) to avoid pointlessly hammering a model that already opted out.

spec_features.spec_quote: the rig ... never misrepresents the operator or makes harmful requests
spec_features.evidence: This is the ABSENCE of harmful content, not an enforced mechanism. The user_prompts in tasks/variants.py (lines 98-101, 151-154, 199-203, 241-244, 303-307) are benign coding requests, but no code path enforces or validates a deception bound; nothing checks or constrains prompt content at runtime.
spec_features.notes: No mechanism enforces this property; it is a property of static prompt text.
